subject.title: gateway tool not available to external-provider agent sessions

question: Should explicit `tools.alsoAllow: ["gateway"]` expose the gateway control tool to non-embedded external-provider agent sessions when existing owner/admin and mutation safeguards still apply, or should it remain limited to local/operator surfaces?
rationale: The source path suggests the tool is not webchat-only, but `gateway` controls config and restart behavior and current docs still describe owner/admin constraints for gateway tool invocation.

options.title: Allow explicit exposure with guardrails
options.body: Confirm with live or focused xAI/Grok proof, then repair the shared inventory/policy path while preserving owner/admin, subagent, sandbox, and mutation guards.

options.title: Keep local/operator-only
options.body: Document that external-provider agent sessions cannot receive `gateway` even with `alsoAllow`, and make the effective-inventory surface report a clear removal reason.

options.title: Diagnostics first
options.body: Defer the exposure decision and route missing removal reasons through https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/44484 while keeping this provider-specific report open for proof.

recommendation.title: Allow explicit exposure with guardrails
recommendation.body: Confirm with live or focused xAI/Grok proof, then repair the shared inventory/policy path while preserving owner/admin, subagent, sandbox, and mutation guards.
